$comment: Drop this in your Swift project root as `afk.config.json` and commit it. NO secrets and NO machine-specific paths: the Telegram chat ID is read from the AFK_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var each dev sets once in their shell rc. Swift projects typically don't need the symlink dance, so `postCreateWorktree` runs `swift package resolve` instead. Leave it off entirely if a fresh worktree needs no setup.
